runtimeFamilies.name: Daily Runtime
runtimeFamilies.purpose: Discover, research, produce and publish same-day Daily Research.
runtimeFamilies.purpose_zh: 完成当天发现、当天研究、当天生产、当天发布。

runtimeFamilies.name: Weekly Runtime
runtimeFamilies.purpose: Check due P2 objects and execute at most one triggered special study, then synthesize the week's validated research into an independently readable AI Research Brief.
runtimeFamilies.purpose_zh: 检查到期 P2 对象并最多执行一个被触发的专项研究，再把本周已验证研究综合为可独立阅读的 AI Research Brief。

runtimeFamilies.name: Academic Runtime
runtimeFamilies.purpose: Research papers, benchmarks, specifications and institutions only.
runtimeFamilies.purpose_zh: 只研究论文、基准、规范与机构。

runtimeFamilies.name: Research Program Runtime
runtimeFamilies.purpose: Advance long-term research programs through their own lifecycle, queue, review and publication.
runtimeFamilies.purpose_zh: 通过独立生命周期、队列、评审与发布推进长期研究计划。

tasks.name: Research Runtime Discovery
tasks.input: AI Platform Change Intelligence, GitHub Engineering Intelligence and Published Research Intelligence.
tasks.work: Execute the three intelligence profiles, normalize and deduplicate same-day signals.

tasks.name: Research Runtime Queue
tasks.work: Make one Selected or No Selection decision for each of the three research columns.

tasks.name: Research Runtime Reading
tasks.input: Selected objects in Today's Research Plan
tasks.work: Perform source-complete Deep Reading and evidence extraction.

tasks.name: Research Runtime Analysis
tasks.work: State the research question, classify evidence identities, analyze and compare, form a bounded judgment, identify an article type and dynamic modules, map general implications, then test optional first-party relevance.

tasks.name: Research Runtime Production
tasks.work: Write complete bilingual V2 candidates using a selected article type and dynamic modules; classify claim identities and project relevance; persist one same-date Article Cover Brief per eligible object; consume only same-date isolated cover-worker receipts and accepted raster assets; decide and contextually insert 0..N Inline Figures; pass six editorial gates plus Cover, Inline Visual and Article Layout gates; and record an optional Community Edition decision.
prohibitions: Writing from signals or Reading Results
Fixed Cover or Figure image-container sections
Calling image generation from the Production Runtime conversation
Accepting an Article Cover without a valid isolated cover-worker receipt

tasks.name: Research Runtime Publication
tasks.work: Release complete Research Center Editions and separately authorized Community Editions; update GitHub, bilingual website surfaces and indexes; commit, verify and release.

tasks.name: Research Runtime Weekly
tasks.input: Latest-main P2 Registry and checkpoints plus evidence-validated Daily Research from the previous seven days
tasks.work: Check every due P2 object, execute at most one triggered P2 special study, and produce an independently readable AI Research Brief about material weekly changes, connections, evidence, disputes, judgments and open questions.
tasks.output: P2 Check Record, zero or one P2 Special Study, and Weekly Synthesis
prohibitions: More than one P2 special study
Direct publication of a P2 study
Silent omission of a due P2 object

tasks.name: Research Runtime Academic
tasks.input: Paper, benchmark, specification or institution objects
tasks.work: Execute the complete reading, analysis, writing, evidence and editing pipeline.

tasks.name: Research Program Runtime
tasks.input: Independent queues for TMPA, FCoP, CodeFlowMu, Digital Employee and Research Operating System
tasks.work: Advance eligible program objects through Program Queue, Research, Review and Program Publication.
tasks.output: Program Runtime Record and governed program transition
